reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests a new behavior—the woman rides the dragon into a battleground—so the action is request-governed rather than the subject sheets' static poses.
reasons.medium: The host medium decision is preserve, so no rendering departure is authorized; the reference photoreal/live-action visual medium is retained.
reasons.wardrobe: The request explicitly names a technical jacket, governing that wardrobe property; the remaining observed clothing is retained through the resolved identity requirements.
reasons.lighting: No illuminating source, direction or visible light quality is requested; cinematic/dramatic mood and battleground setting do not authorize replacing the reference lighting.
reasons.framing: The brief explicitly requests camera movements, which is actual requested camera behavior and therefore governs framing; the chosen aspect ratio alone would not.
reasons.palette: No explicit color grade, hue, saturation or tonal-contrast instruction is given; cinematic/dramatic wording is treatment language, not a requested palette, so the reference palette governs.
